title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Koramangala

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Koramangala for your startup or growing team? SAMAN Portable manufactures new, factory-built container offices and supplies them across south-east Bengaluru, including the Koramangala startup and commercial belt. As a direct manufacturer — not a reseller or marketplace — we build each unit to order on a steel frame, finish it for office use, and deliver it ready to plug in.

Container Offices for Sale in Koramangala

SAMAN Portable sells new container offices in Koramangala in 10ft, 20ft and 40ft sizes, built to order and delivered ready to use. Each unit is fabricated on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, fitted with door, windows, wiring points and finishing, then transported to your Koramangala site. Pricing depends on size and fittings — request a current quote.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard container office sizes. All are built new at our Bengaluru factory and can be customised for your layout and use.

SizeApprox. floor areaTypical use
10ft~80 sq ftSingle cabin, site office, guard or supervisor desk
20ft~160 sq ftSmall team workspace, meeting room or combined office
40ft~320 sq ftLarger office, reception plus workstations, or multi-zone unit

Need more space? Units can be placed side by side or stacked to create a larger office for a bigger team. Tell us your headcount and we will recommend the right configuration.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying direct from the manufacturer means no middleman markup and full control over how your unit is built. Every SAMAN container office is fabricated at our factory in Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099.

  • Steel built to standard: each office uses an MS steel frame built to IS 2062, with proper alignment of roof, walls, door and base.
  • Quality system: SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Delivery: standard delivery is ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days to most Bengaluru locations.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Koramangala

We deliver container offices across Bengaluru, including Koramangala and the surrounding south-east Bengaluru commercial areas. Units are fabricated at the Gopasandra factory and transported to your site, with typical transit of 3–5 days after the unit is ready. Because Koramangala plots and tech-park premises can have tight access and limited turning room, share your site address, gate width and the placement point when you enquire so we can plan the right vehicle and offload approach.

Get a container office quote in Koramangala

Ready to price your unit? Tell us the size, layout and any fittings you need, and we will send a current quote with delivery to Koramangala. Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry button on this page. You can also explore our full container office range to compare sizes before you order.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in Koramangala?

SAMAN supplies 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices in Koramangala. Units can also be combined side by side or stacked for larger teams. Each one is built new to order.


How long does delivery to Koramangala take?

Typical transit is 3–5 days after your unit is fabricated, with standard delivery at ₹3,000 to most Bengaluru locations. Share your Koramangala site access details so we can plan the offload.


Can I customise my container office?

Yes. We build to order, so you can choose the layout, doors and windows, wiring points, and interior finish to suit a workstation area, meeting room or reception. Tell us your use and headcount.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Are your container offices new or used?

New. Every unit is fabricated to order on an MS steel frame built to IS 2062 at our Bengaluru factory. We do not sell second-hand or refurbished containers.


How do I order a container office for Koramangala?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size, layout and site address. We will confirm specification and send a current quote with delivery to Koramangala.

With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
